note: Historical replay. Events and traffic are real (IMF PortWatch); each shipment is a synthetic example routed through the affected place. Decisions use only what was known the day after the event started.

scenarios.rationale: RED SEA TENSIONS (security_threat, high risk). Cheapest available option: invoke_force_majeure at about $0. The clause covers this kind of event. Written notice is due by 2023-12-19 00:00 UTC.
scenarios.summary: RED SEA TENSIONS started 16 Dec 2023. The example shipment (Shanghai → Rotterdam) matches via route chokepoint (Bab el-Mandeb Strait), 26 days before its ETA. PortGuard would recommend **invoke force majeure** (high risk): waiting would cost ~$10,000, the best available option ~$0. Over the following month, measured transits at Bab el-Mandeb Strait changed -41% vs the month before.
